title: Trust and Safety Standard — Strike Nights on the Listings Minimum Stay
content:
# Strike Nights on the Minimum Stay

*Trust and Safety standard for Roamhaven Listings, read against the host's Host Accounts record.*

## Standard

Because the party ban applies to every space type, a listing whose records show party risk carries party-prevention nights on top of the standard minimum-stay floor, each worked out on the day of the change. **Strike nights** are one kind of party-prevention night. They are read from the strikes of type **party violation** recorded on the Host Accounts record of the host account the listing belongs to, within the last twelve months (fewer than twelve whole months before the day of the change):

| Party-violation strikes recorded on the host account in that window | Strike nights |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | 2 nights |
| exactly 1 | 1 night |
| none | none |

Strikes of any other type — discrimination, off-platform payment, misrepresentation, safety violation or review manipulation — are not party-violation strikes and are not counted.

## Cases (hypothetical host accounts)

- One party-violation strike recorded five months ago and one recorded eleven months ago: two in the window, 2 strike nights.
- One party-violation strike recorded five months ago and one recorded thirteen months ago: one in the window, 1 strike night.
- One safety-violation strike recorded two months ago and no party-violation strike: no strike nights.
